The workflows are on `action_required` (fork gate) — could a maintainer press "Approve and run workflows"? Local verification on HEAD (up to date with `master`):

- `bundle exec rake spec` — full suite green (test-queue, all workers 0 failures)
- `bundle exec rake internal_investigation` — 126 files, no offenses
- `bundle exec rspec spec/rubocop/cop/performance/double_start_end_with_spec.rb` — 38 examples, 0 failures (green under `PARSER_ENGINE=parser_prism` too)
- `bundle exec rspec spec/project_spec.rb` — 71 examples, 0 failures (no `@safety`/config/alphabetical drift)

The two new "impure receiver" specs (bare method call, method-call chain) fail on `master`.
